mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a right over property given by a debtor to a creditor whereby the latter in the event of the debtor's failure acquires priority over the property against the general body of creditors of the debtor."

A right in security is a right over property given by a debtor to a creditor whereby the latter in the event of the debtor's failure acquires priority over the property against the general body of creditors of the debtor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum or totality of all claims against a person."
A debt is the sum or totality of all claims against a person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the pledge, lien, mortgage and charge."
Numerus clausus are the pledge, lien, mortgage and charge.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the proprietary right of the debtor in a thing granted and donated to the creditor to secure repayment of loan or discharge of an obligation."
Security interest is the proprietary right of the debtor in a thing granted and donated to the creditor to secure repayment of loan or discharge of an obligation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the contribution of the members to the company and expressed in shares."
Equity is the contribution of the members to the company and expressed in shares.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first form of possessory security."
The pledge is the first form of possessory security.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as in rem or real security.36 Real security is granted to the creditor, and it is this grant that makes him a secured creditor."
Direct security is the same as in rem or real security.36 Real security is granted to the creditor, and it is this grant that makes him a secured creditor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrument acknowledging indebtedness and may or may not be secured."
The debenture is an instrument acknowledging indebtedness and may or may not be secured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the registry for security interests created under and pursuant to the STMA 2017."
The NCR is the registry for security interests created under and pursuant to the STMA 2017.
fib: ______ is the statutory power of sale available to an unpaid seller as a lienee under section 39(1)(c) of the Sale of Goods Act 1893.
instance
An instance is the statutory power of sale available to an unpaid seller as a lienee under section 39(1)(c) of the Sale of Goods Act 1893.
______ is a determinant of the efficiency of the financial system.
Efficiency of financial intermediation
Efficiency of financial intermediation is a determinant of the efficiency of the financial system.
______ is the oldest means of creating security interest in property for the repayment of loan or discharge of an obligation.
pledge contract
The pledge contract is the oldest means of creating security interest in property for the repayment of loan or discharge of an obligation.
______ is a form of consensual security and may be fixed or floating.
charge
A charge is a form of consensual security and may be fixed or floating.
______ is a driver of economic activity.
supply of credit
The supply of credit is a driver of economic activity.
______ is an equitable charge over the whole or a specified part of the company's undertakings and assets including present and future assets.
Floating charge
Floating charge is an equitable charge over the whole or a specified part of the company's undertakings and assets including present and future assets.
______ is the bundle of rights exercisable by an owner in respect of his property.
Proprietary right
Proprietary right is the bundle of rights exercisable by an owner in respect of his property.
______ is the Land Use Act, which makes it mandatory for the consent of the Governor of a State to be sought and obtained in respect of transactions in land comprised in any state of the Federation.
Prominent among such laws

Prominent among such laws is the Land Use Act, which makes it mandatory for the consent of the Governor of a State to be sought and obtained in respect of transactions in land comprised in any state of the Federation.
______ is a right which is not, legally, represented by a document.
pure intangible
A pure intangible is a right which is not, legally, represented by a document.
